name: Long session that only touches motivation, never probing logistics/comp/compliance/commitment/benefits

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I'm a frontend engineer with 6 years of experience, mostly React and design systems.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Why are you interested in our company?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I've followed your design-system blog for a while and the recent component-library launch is exactly the space I want to go deeper in.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: What kind of team environment do you do your best work in?

transcript.text: Small teams with strong design partnership and short feedback loops.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Where do you see yourself in three to five years?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Leading a design-systems org and mentoring frontend engineers across product teams.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: What would you say is your biggest strength?

transcript.speaker: user
